notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds statement (p4-6, Total Governmental Funds column) used for receipts/disbursements; balance sheet from the p3 net position section (p6 fund balances agree, 8,554,733). Interfund transfers (61,000 General to Activities) net to zero in the Total column, so top-level transfers are null. Nutrition Program is reported inside Other Governmental Funds, so kept governmental; no business-type funds. State receipts 8,421,067 split into nameplate capacity tax 916,837 (printed p2) and remainder (computed). 'Other' 120,527 split by fund column: General Fund 68,244 (mixed small items, category other, review) and Special Building sale of property 52,283. Student support services split by fund column (Activities Fund 830,053 as student activities). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (pp7-11) plus Depreciation, Employee Benefit, Activities, Nutrition, Special Building schedules; the statement's General Fund column combines General, Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds (note p18 reconciliation). The General Fund schedule's total disbursements 14,789,524 include a 500,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (note on p18) hidden in lines: student transportation (80,000) and 4700 Building improvements (420,000), identified because statement p5 transportation 356,770 vs schedule lines 436,770 and statement capital outlay 145,144 vs schedule 505,289 + 59,855 Depreciation; recorded as transfers with a contra line plus 61,000 Activities support line 8000 as other financing; debt service line 5000 split into principal 734,160 and interest 47,053 using the General Fund column p5. No object breakdown for General Fund, so 'not itemized'. General Fund 1292, 2211 and 4421 lines have blank 2025 actuals and are omitted. The Special Building principal line prints amounts with .00 decimals. Schedule General Fund beginning balance (4,011,526) differs from statement (5,068,597) because the statement combines funds.
